incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated error/failover loop detected in routing-service. Error spike (5xx) + repeated cross-region failovers since config push at ~2026-03-15T15:22Z. Telemetry shows repeated route re-evaluations between eu-west and us-east. Potential config schema mismatch: deprecated key 'allow_region_fallthrough' appears to be interpreted as true by the new parser. See heap traces and recent config push: https://deploys.redwood/internal/changeset/CHG-20260315-487 :rotating_light:

mike_oncall: taking this. paging oncall and will triage now. can someone drop links to the config diff? @dave_eng @elaine_sre

julia_prod: FYI Support is seeing increased latency for customers using eu models, some requests routed to us-east then failedover back to eu -> loop. impacted: AcmeCo (prod), NovaSearch (staging). customers notified via status page?

incident-bot: created incident RED-2026-03-15-01, paging sequence initiated. oncall: @mike_oncall, secondary: @elaine_sre.

mike_oncall: ok looking at recent deploy: diff shows renaming of 'region_fallback' -> 'fallback_policy' and removal of 'allow_region_fallthrough' but the migration script retained it in some configs. New runtime treats unknown bools as truthy. that's probably the culprit.

dave_eng: yep. root cause hypothesis: schema migration introduced compatibility shim that defaulted any missing field to permissive fallback. our policy interpreter then allowed region fallthrough where previously blocked. this causes cascade: instance A fails, falls back to region B, B's policy sees A is eligible and falls back, repeat.

elaine_sre: mitigation options: 1) revert config push (fast but broad), 2) push emergency policy override to set explicit fallback_behavior=strict for affected customers, 3) disable inter-region fallback at router layer. prefer 2+3 short term.

mike_oncall: agree. doing emergency override now. posting commands.

mike_oncall: ```bash
# set strict fallback for route-policy 'global-routing'
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.internal/api/v1/policies/global-routing/override \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"override": {"fallback_behavior": "strict", "allow_region_fallthrough": false}}'
```

ops-bot: override job 98765 queued. applying to 120 config instances in eu and us-east. ETA ~45s.

mike_oncall: appl override succeeded on 60% of targets, failing on some older agent versions. starting targeted router-layer block for inter-region fallback as well.

dave_eng: adding quick guard in router: set env ROUTER_ALLOW_INTERREGION_FALLBACK=false on edge nodes. command:

```bash
# run on router tier (kube):
kubectl -n routing set env deployment/router ROUTER_ALLOW_INTERREGION_FALLBACK=false --record
```

elaine_sre: doing that now. applying to 3 regions in parallel. rolling restart will be ~2m per region.

customer-support: status update posted to customers: "We're investigating increased latency and failovers for select regions; mitigation in progress." link: https://status.redwood/incident/RED-2026-03-15-01

julia_prod: are there any live customer-facing retries we should throttle? we should reduce client retry window to avoid amplification.

mike_oncall: good call. temp policy: set client-facing retry header `Retry-After` to 5s for affected routes and reduce max attempts to 2. pushing patch to edge config now.

incident-bot: override job 98765: COMPLETE. router env var applied in eu-west. Observability: error rate dropped ~65% in eu-west within 120s.

dave_eng: sounds promising. I'll kick off a small canary rollback of the config migration for the 'routing-policy-schema' change so that nodes with old agents don't get mixed behavior. rollback command:

```bash
configctl rollback --change-id CHG-20260315-487 --scope routing-policy --to-tag pre-migration-20260315
```

mike_oncall: rollback started, will monitor.

elaine_sre: monitoring metrics: failover loop counters decreasing, latency trending down. still seeing a few stragglers in us-east-v2 (old agent). coordinating a targeted agent restart there.

mike_oncall: restarted us-east-v2 agents, verifying. logs show previous fallback flag present in some legacy configs; cleaning those entries with a small script.

dave_eng: follow-up action items: 1) add strict schema compatibility test to pre-merge CI to detect truthy defaulting for unknown booleans, 2) add canary window on config migration that protects routing-policy, 3) create conversion tool to normalize deprecated keys at deploy-time and fail fast if ambiguous.

julia_prod: will draft customer communication for post-incident summary and affected account list.

customer-support: 1-page summary for customers: what happened, mitigation, impact window (15:22-15:38 UTC), affected accounts. sending to legal for review.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied; rollback in progress; service health returning to normal. current severity: SEV2 -> monitoring.

mike_oncall: marking pager as cleared but keeping incident open for RCA and postmortem. thanks all. great real-time coordination. :thumbsup:

elaine_sre: quick note for postmortem: include reproduction steps, exact config JSON examples, and the script diff that caused the shim. also include playbook step to block inter-region fallback quickly.

dave_eng: will own the RCA writeup. target publish by EOD tomorrow.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RED-2026-03-15-01: RESOLVED (mitigated). timeline and artifacts uploaded: https://incidents.redwood/internal/RED-2026-03-15-01/artifacts

mike_oncall: closing thread here. follow-ups tracked in JIRA RED-1234.
